<title level="1" right="Rules">[Steps 1 and 2](/Rules.aspx?ID=107)</title>

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 30 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Adam is making his first Pathfinder character. After talking about it with the rest of the group, he’s decided to make a [dwarven](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=1) [druid](/Classes.aspx?ID=6). After jotting down a few ideas, he begins by writing down a 10 for each ability score.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</row>
